|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of Away Put Your Weapon (V), the text of the PC website card list; it is the current text. Other versions: [[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon-PC-E3-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; renamed from VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png on 11 November 2026 when the versions were put in date order). The first printing of September 2009 is lost; see the history below. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009<ref name="pc-news-2009-09-16">Players Committee news post “Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)”, 16 September 2009 (the Virtual Sets realigned into Virtual Blocks 1–5). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102746/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=70 Internet Archive]</ref>. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-awayputyourweapon-pre.gif]], slip number 140E, errata mark E) prints: “USED: An opponent's just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny is -3. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Once per game, retrieve up to 5 weapons (may take one retrieved card into hand).” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-r1">Lee Edwards' Star Wars CCG V-kit (swccgvkit-legacy), slip image <code>public/images/vslips/virtual5-light/awayputyourweapon.png</code> (slip #140E), in Subversion revision 1, committed 9 December 2009 (<code>.svn/entries</code>; [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips GitHub copy])</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list stamps the card “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”<ref name="cl-1220_139-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026). It is the earliest surviving text of the card.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) changed “up to 5 weapons” to “up to five weapons”: “USED: An opponent's just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny is -3. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Once per game, retrieve up to five weapons (may take one retrieved card into hand).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 139E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon.png]]) shows this text. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version, because the PC website card list already showed PC-E3.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013), where the entry is marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, changed “up to five weapons” to “up to 5 weapons” and “retrieved” to “retireved” (typo as published): “USED: An opponent's just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny is -3. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Once per game, retrieve up to 5 weapons (may take one retireved card into hand).”<ref name="cl-1220_139-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> It is the latest text, so it is the current text.
